import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)
def cnt(n):
    N=3*n
    vis=[[0]*3 for _ in range(n)]
    tot=0
    def go(x,y,k):
        nonlocal tot
        if k==N:
            if y==0: tot+=1
            return
        for nx,ny in ((x,y-1),(x,y+1),((x+1)%n,y)):
            if 0<=ny<3 and not vis[nx][ny]:
                vis[nx][ny]=1;go(nx,ny,k+1);vis[nx][ny]=0
    for x in range(n):
        vis[x][2]=1;go(x,2,1);vis[x][2]=0
    return tot
for n in range(2,13):print(n,cnt(n))
